baseline: 0.8.45 immutable release source; task declarations not simultaneous live tasks
caveats: SDK internal tasks beyond the explicitly included main/speaker/HID/MSC are not enumerated by source calls here. Use on-device task snapshot for live total.
Stack sizes and priorities are declarations, not measured usage or observed affinity.
Task stack and heap usage is additional to linked static data/BSS; task totals are not a peak memory sum.
